meta.name: competitor-spy
meta.description: Reverse-engineer successful affiliate strategies from competitors. Use this skill when the user asks about spying on competitors, researching what other affiliates promote, analyzing competitor affiliate sites, understanding how top affiliates in a niche make money, or says "what programs does X promote", "how does [site] make money", "what affiliate strategy does this site use", "spy on competitor affiliates", "reverse engineer affiliate site", "copy what works in my niche", "who are the top affiliates in X niche", "what content gets traffic in my niche", "competitor affiliate analysis".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析竞争对手的联盟营销策略，找出成功模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做联盟营销，想了解对手的推广方法
copy.tagline_en: Reverse-engineer competitors' affiliate strategies to discover winning patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run affiliate marketing and want to study competitors' tactics

howto.what: Claude 能分析竞争对手的网站、YouTube 频道等，找出他们推广的联盟计划、内容策略和流量来源，并输出一份反向工程报告，总结可复制的策略。
howto.when: 当你询问竞争对手的联盟策略，例如“这个网站怎么赚钱”、“谁是X领域的顶级联盟成员”，或要求“反向工程联盟网站”时触发。

say.text: 分析一下 example.com 的联盟策略
say.note: Claude 会抓取该网站，识别其推广计划。

say.text: AI工具领域，顶级YouTuber推广哪些联盟计划？
say.note: Claude 会搜索并列出他们的推荐。

say.text: 邮件营销领域有哪些内容空白？
say.note: Claude 会对比竞争对手，找出未覆盖的主题。

howto.what_en: Claude can analyze competitor sites, YouTube channels, etc., to identify which affiliate programs they promote, their content strategy, and traffic sources, then output a reverse-engineering report summarizing replicable tactics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about competitor affiliate strategies, e.g., 'How does this site make money?', 'Who are top affiliates in X niche?', or request to 'reverse engineer an affiliate site'.

say_en.text: Analyze the affiliate strategy of example.com
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the site and identify promoted programs.

say_en.text: What affiliate programs do top YouTubers in AI tools promote?
say_en.note: Claude will search and list their recommendations.

say_en.text: What content gaps exist in the email marketing niche?
say_en.note: Claude will compare competitors to find uncovered topics.
